headline: Brent Crude Rises After Refinery Attack and Strait of Hormuz Mine Strikes
summary: Crude oil prices advanced after reports of an attack on Saudi Arabia's largest oil refinery and mine strikes on vessels in the Strait of Hormuz.
why: The Strait of Hormuz and Middle Eastern production facilities are critical arteries for global crude oil supply, meaning disruptions directly impact global energy costs.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Supply disruptions and attacks on key Middle Eastern oil infrastructure directly threaten crude availability, pushing prices higher.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Geopolitical attacks on major oil refining infrastructure and transit routes stoke fears of tight global petroleum supplies.
